verdict.rationale: Oracle's own docs describe an OCI Terraform provider that connects Terraform to the OCI services you manage, and Resource Manager can import existing Terraform state, so the provider is real and documented first-party. The pack does not show active releases, the breadth of service coverage, or OpenTofu compatibility. Missing for 10: evidence of active release cadence, explicit coverage of core services (compute, networking, storage, databases), OpenTofu support, independent or hands-on corroboration.
